Samir Patel: FYI customer BrightLeaf LLC says they were charged WA sales tax on invoice INV-2026-0421 even though PO-7782 shows a Washington reseller exemption. Can someone triage? :eyes:

Molly (Finance): Thanks, Samir. I pulled the invoice — amount looks right but tax = $8.25 applied. Customer claims tax-exempt flag was on the PO.

Samir Patel: Customer provided the PO PDF and a written reseller certificate. They say billing address in their account is CA HQ, but PO bill-to is WA reseller entity. Suspect address fallback logic used account address for tax jurisdiction.

Jenna Ortiz: Do we have the payload used to create the invoice? If tax provider sees CA, it will apply CA tax. Can you paste the request body or invoice metadata?

Samir Patel: Here is the invoice metadata we received from checkout webhook (redacted):
```
{
  "customer": "cust_9xkV",
  "billing_address": {
    "line1": "300 Market St",
    "city": "San Francisco",
    "region": "CA",
    "postal_code": "94105",
    "country": "US"
  },
  "po_number": "PO-7782",
  "po_bill_to": {
    "company": "BrightLeaf NW LLC",
    "line1": "12 Harbor Ave",
    "city": "Seattle",
    "region": "WA",
    "postal_code": "98101",
    "country": "US"
  }
}
```

Ethan (Payments): Looks like our invoice generator is only sending billing_address to TaxResolver. PO bill-to is not present in the tax call. That would explain WA exemption not being considered.

Molly (Finance): Customer included reseller certificate number RC-9934 on the PO. We should accept that as evidence and issue a credit for the tax portion. Need confirmation on process.

Jenna Ortiz: Quick repro steps I used locally: 1) create customer with account billing address CA 2) attach PO metadata with po_bill_to region WA and certificate RC-9934 3) generate invoice -> observed TaxResolver call: `POST /tax/calc` payload contained only `billing_address` and `line_items`. No `po_bill_to` or `exemption_certificate` fields.

Jenna Ortiz: Stack: tax provider = TaxEngine (internal adapter to third-party). I traced adapter code in commit 5a2f3a — it constructs tax call from invoice.billing_address and invoice.customer_tax_info but ignores po metadata.

Ethan (Payments): Proposed immediate fix: include `po_bill_to` region and any `exemption_certificate` metadata when building tax request. Hotfix + deploy to staging, then prod after smoke tests.

Samir Patel: Customer asked for ETA and credit. Molly, can finance approve a tax-only credit pending fix? I'll offer a temporary workaround: they can update account billing address to WA entity but that is not acceptable for them long-term.

Molly (Finance): Approve tax-only credit for INV-2026-0421. Credit amount $8.25. I'll open the credit note and mark reason = "reseller certificate on PO". Please confirm before issuing.

Samir Patel: Confirmed. Issue credit and attach PO PDF and reseller certificate to the ticket.

InvoiceBot: Credit note CN-2026-110 created for INV-2026-0421 amount 8.25 USD by Molly (Finance). Reference: ticket #SUP-12942.

Jenna Ortiz: I'll open a PR for the hotfix and tag eng-runtime for review. Steps: (1) modify tax_request builder to merge `invoice.metadata.po_bill_to` and `invoice.metadata.exemption_certificate` into the tax payload, (2) add unit tests, (3) add e2e with sample PO data.

Ethan (Payments): After deploy, we should run a backfill for invoices in last 30 days with PO metadata to detect others affected and auto-create credits where certificate present. I'll draft backfill script once hotfix is merged.

Samir Patel: Customer update sent: "Thanks, appreciate the quick handling and the credit. We'll wait for the fix so our billing flow doesn't require changing account addresses." :thumbsup:

Molly (Finance): Done — credit issued and customer notified. I'll sync with Jenna on the test cases needed to ensure exemptions are honored.

Jenna Ortiz: Note for eng-runtime reviewers: watch out for edge-case where po_bill_to has country but missing region. Fallback should still prefer explicit PO jurisdiction for tax-exempt resolution.

Samir Patel: Closing loop here. Marking thread resolved once PR is merged and backfill plan created. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
